author: jondot
text:
Copilot in Visual Studio couldn't edit its own .mcp.json. The check compared filenames, so a write to ".mcp.json." passed, Windows dropped the dot, and a new MCP server ran. CVE-2026-103572, fixed in October.

A string compare is a human-era control. Agents need new primitives.
